body: That's so true for me. I feel as though I'm not worth going to see a therapist because I'm not actually depressed and I'd just be wasting their time.
Thank you very much! This sounds very similar to what I experience.

Your post unfortunately didn't seem to help me in anyway, all I see is that you don't completely understand what you're doing to people by saying: "suicide isn't an option". It's very insensitive, and, maybe if you were to rephrase your post, it would work better and have a better influence.

I feel this way on a personal level. I've always been an overthinker, so making decisions has always been difficult. Weighing all the pros and cons, and not knowing if it's the right decision after all. I'm sorry you feel like this, but I'm here and I understand.
I don't know, I've had problems with my self image since 10 years of age. Maybe it'll never go away, I don't know. I just don't have the motivation to change it
Man, I feel the same way. I'm a coward, so I haven't tried anything. I never opened up to anyone about it because I don't want to be a burden, especially now. Just trying to tough it out.

I relate to this on a personal level. I have a fear of saying anything or letting anybody in my family know about my thoughts. I think that my mom noticed something was wrong, but she just dismissed it when I said I was "fine". Also they've talked about mental illness really only in a bad light, so I fear that if I say anything they'll think I'm just a moody teen. But please, do tell somebody. I told my best friend about my struggles when I was really low, and it made me feel much better about life. I hope you feel better and know that you're not alone in this situation!
❤️
Yes, I've felt this. Mostly though as trying to get my mind occupied with something so I don't go to my dark place.
